## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/gspc-affect`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/gspc-affect -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `NOTICE`
- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `affect.json`
- `items.jsonl`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-affect at revision `5a93f9e9de9245ded3d8a6cf62d6a373522e2b47`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC — affect bank (AffectBench)

Council of AI measurement bank. Measurement, not certification.

**Bank.** Frozen split. Live `n` is the matching axis on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`, not a Hub score. **Not a certificate.** Art 50 (EUR-Lex): 2 August 2026 live; marking grace 2 December 2026.


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `affect` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=affect` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.

`axis-live.jsonl` is a one-row snapshot of this axis as the live board returned it at that moment. It is a snapshot, not the authority.
